title: Blocking items still unaddressed in round 2 needed no disposition

found.context: Live runs of the untested 0.5.0 paths on the demo project, 2026-11-03: panel round 2

observed_failure: In round 2 all five seats found blocking items R-1, R-7 and R-8 not addressed, and others partly. panel_check.py counted only the round's new findings as blocking, so it reported 0 blocking items, and G4 would have passed with no disposition for any of them.
expected_behavior: Every blocking roadmap item of the verified round that the seats did not find addressed stays blocking, judged from the seats' checks rather than the synthesizer's roadmap, and needs a disposition keyed panel:R-#.

resolution.summary: panel_check.py reports standing roadmap items; g4_check.py requires their dispositions

lessons: A gate that counts only new findings lets every old one through the second round.
